svg.title: Payments and what to know about them
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 7 components and 6 connections in 2 boundaries. Cloud account: API gateway, Ledger, Card data zone. Card data zone (in Cloud account): Payment service, Token vault. Main path: Shopper → Checkout → API gateway → Payment service → Card provider. Most connected: Payment service (4 connections). Nothing leads into Shopper. Nothing leads out of Token vault, Ledger and Card provider. Bottleneck: API gateway; without it the diagram falls apart. Shopper (person): connects to Checkout (pays). Checkout (frontend): connects to API gateway (via HTTPS). API gateway (service): connects to Payment service (charge). Payment service (service): connects to Token vault (tokenizes), Card provider (authorizes, via HTTPS) and Ledger (records, via SQL). Token vault (security): no outgoing connection. Ledger (database): no outgoing connection. Card provider (external system): no outgoing connection. Note on Token vault: Card numbers never leave the vault; everything else sees tokens. Note on Card data zone: Audited once a year; changes need a second reviewer. Note: Figures and names are illustrative; the diagram shows the target state.
